A dragon has 3 heads. When one head is cut off, 2 new heads grow. If a knight cuts off 5 heads, how many heads will the dragon have?
Priya thinks of a number. She doubles it, adds 10, divides by 2, and subtracts 3. The result is 12. What number did Priya think of?

A frog jumps between lily pads numbered 1 to 10 in a row. Each jump is exactly 3 pads forward or 2 pads backward. Starting at pad 1, what is the minimum number of jumps to reach pad 10?

On a die, opposite sides always add up to 7. If you can see 1, 2, and 3 on a die, what is the sum of the three hidden faces?

Zara and Axel start at point A on a circle. Zara walks clockwise, Axel walks counter-clockwise. They meet at B, then C, then D, then back at A. These points divide the circle into 4 equal parts. How many times has Axel gone around the circle?
Hans feeds six sheep a total of 210g of food. Five large sheep each get the same amount, and the small sheep gets twice as much as each large sheep. How much food does the small sheep get?

Jana has toys weighing 22g, 23g, 25g, 34g, and 36g. She wants to divide them into two boxes of equal weight. Which two toys must NOT go in the same box?
On a calendar, two shaded boxes in the same column add up to 29. If these boxes are on the same weekday, what day is the 1st of the month?
In a number wall, each brick shows the sum of the two bricks below it. The bottom row has 1, 2, 3, 4 from left to right. What is the number at the top of the wall?

Cruz writes the numbers 1, 3, 5, 7 in boxes: □ × □ - □ × □. What order gives the biggest result?

options: None - he can measure any weight up to 40g

questions.question: In a tournament, every team plays every other team once. There are 28 games in total. How many teams are playing?
A snail climbs a 10-meter well. Each day it climbs 3m, but each night it slides back 2m. On which day does it reach the top?
Three boxes contain apples. Box A has twice as many as Box B. Box C has 4 more than Box A. Together they have 44 apples. How many are in Box C?
A secret code replaces each letter with the next letter (A→B, B→C, ... Z→A). If 'DOH' becomes 'EPJ' after one step, what was the original word before 'DOH'?
Five friends weigh 30kg, 32kg, 35kg, 38kg, and 40kg. They need to use an elevator that holds max 70kg. At least how many trips are needed?
Arlo drew a board with 9 squares and wrote numbers starting from 1, adding 3 each time (1, 4, 7, 10, ...). Which number could be in one of the squares?
Whenever a kangaroo hops up 7 steps, a rabbit hops down 3 steps. They start at step 100. When the kangaroo reaches step 156, what step is the rabbit on?
Vera, Lena and Rosa have 100 reais together. Vera has twice as much as each friend. After each pays for a movie ticket, Vera has 3 times what both friends have together. How much was the ticket?

A hotel has floors 1-30, each with rooms 1-20. Room codes join floor and room numbers (e.g., floor 11 room 1 = '111'). Code '111' is confusing (could be floor 1 room 11 or floor 11 room 1). How many confusing codes exist?
In a nursery group there are 14 girls and 12 boys. Half of the group go for a walk. What is the minimum number of girls that must be in that group?
In an enclosure, the sum of all kangaroos' ages is 36 years. In two years, all kangaroos together will be 60 years old. How many kangaroos are in the enclosure?

Emil takes selfies with his 8 cousins. Each cousin appears in 2 or 3 photos. Each photo has exactly 5 cousins. How many selfies does Emil take?
Linus builds a 4×4×4 cube using 32 white and 32 black small cubes. He arranges them so the surface has as much white as possible. What fraction of the surface is white?
Susanne is 6 years old. Her sister Lisa is 2 years younger. Brother Max is 2 years older than Susanne. How old are the 3 siblings altogether?
Leonie has stamps for digits 0-9. She stamps the date 15.03.2018. How many different stamps does she use?

Felix the rabbit has 20 carrots and eats 2 each day. He ate the 12th carrot on a Wednesday. On which day did he start eating?
On 8 flowers, butterflies and dragonflies sit (at most 1 per flower). More than half the flowers are occupied. Butterflies = 2 × dragonflies. How many butterflies?
To slay a dragon, Mathias cuts off heads. When 3 heads are cut, 1 grows back. After cutting 13 heads total, the dragon dies. How many heads did it have initially?

Four brothers ate 11 biscuits total. Everyone ate at least 1, all different amounts. Three brothers ate 9, one of them ate exactly 3. How many did the one who ate most have?
In a 4×4 table with numbers [1,2,1,3; 4,1,1,2; 1,7,3,2; 2,1,3,1], find the 2×2 square with the greatest sum. What is this sum?

A 4 by 7 board has 28 white squares. Ira paints 2 whole rows and 1 whole column. How many white squares remain?
Lizzy spends 7 identical coins on three fruits. The three prices are different positive whole numbers of coins. What is the largest possible price of the most expensive fruit?

Laura eats 2 more plums than Sophie. Bettina eats 3 fewer than Laura. Clara eats 1 more than Bettina and 3 fewer than Alice. Which two girls eat the same number of plums?
A gold rocket and a silver rocket make 20 stars in total. The gold rocket makes 6 more stars than the silver rocket. How many stars does the gold rocket make?
An ice cream shop drawer has some money in it. After 6 ice creams are sold, it has 70 euros. After 16 ice creams are sold, it has 120 euros. How much money was in the drawer at the start?

Susanne is 7 years old. Her sister is 3 years younger, and her brother is 2 years older than Susanne. How old are the three children altogether?
Leonie has digit stamps from 0 to 9. She stamps the date 21.03.2024. How many different digit stamps does she use?

On 10 flowers, at most one insect sits on each flower. More than half but fewer than 8 flowers are occupied. The number of butterflies is twice the number of dragonflies. How many butterflies are there?
A belt has 6 holes in a row, each 2 cm from the next. How much longer is the belt when closed at the first hole instead of the sixth?

14 children registered for a contest, then 20 more joined. Six equal teams are needed. How many more children are needed?

A train line has stations A-B-C-D-E-F and then returns back along the same stations. Starting at B toward C, what is the 32nd stop after it leaves B?

Three students guessed the number of library books: 2010, 1998, and 2015. Their errors were 12, 7, and 5 in some order. How many books were there?
Michael paints one letter of KANGAROO each day. He paints K on Wednesday. What day does he paint the last O?

Gregory makes two 3-digit numbers using the digits 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 exactly once. What is the greatest possible sum?
